links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Healthcare has the market but not the relationships, which is the reverse of construction
content:
Healthcare is recorded as sufficiently decentralized — hospitals, Buurtzorg — with both operational and medium-budget decentralization, standardized on FHIR, and with an established consultancy market naming Better (ex-Marant) and Agitavit. Against that: "not well connected atm", and both the PMF question and the companion-software question are marked with a question mark. openEHR is listed as a candidate, with EHRCON26 in Amsterdam on 22–23 September as the entry point.

The mirror-image comparison with construction is instructive. Construction has connections and no consultancy market; healthcare has a consultancy market and no connections. Connections can be built to a schedule — there is a dated conference in the notes — whereas a consultancy market cannot be conjured.

On that reading healthcare is the more tractable of the two gaps, though it needs the companion-software question answered first.
description: Decentralized, standardized on FHIR, with an established consultancy market including Better and Agitavit — but Powerhouse is not well connected there and the companion software is unresolved.
